base_kernel: A10 Universal Lattice Kernel V1.0 A10
notes: V0.2 separates 96 logical tile identities from bounded physical execution slots.
Ordinary signal dictionaries use a native SuperBatch with Python reference fallback.
Attested Host Adapters may emit a 32-byte Aggregate Frame and a lossless 16-bit Decision Token stream bound to the immutable A10 decision LUT.
Decision Token compression changes transport representation only; A10 decision fields and original decision SHA-256 remain recoverable without semantic loss.
Preferred hot lane fuses frame validation, input tree commitments, decision-token generation, and all logical-worker result commitments in one Native traversal.
